```sql
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(population) 
   FROM main."country_history" 
   WHERE effective_month = '2026-05' 
     AND code IN (SELECT "Code" FROM main."country" WHERE "Continent" = 'Asia')) 
  * 1.0 / 
  (SELECT SUM(population) 
   FROM main."country_history" 
   WHERE effective_month = '2026-04' 
     AND code IN (SELECT "Code" FROM main."country" WHERE "Continent" = 'Asia'))
```
